sloka: न हि मन्ये नृशसे त्वम् राजधर्ममवेक्षसे ।गतिम् वा न विजानासि राजवृत्तस्य शाश्वतीम् ॥२-७३-२१॥
transliteration: na hi manye nṛśase tvam rājadharmamavekṣase ।gatim vā na vijānāsi rājavṛttasya śāśvatīm ॥2-73-21॥

translations.english: O cruel one I suppose neither have you any respect for the royal tradition nor are you aware of the everlasting benefit that ensues in following the royal traditon.
